name: 42910-sharegpt-qwen3-8b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B (bf16 target, ~16.4 GB) served with the nm-testing/dflash-qwen3-8b-speculators drafter (~3.6 GB) at a 64-token draft budget. Both checkpoints are public and ungated.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process vLLM engine, no router and no external cache tier; the drafter runs in the same process on the same card.
architecture: TARGET Qwen3ForCausalLM, dense, 36 layers, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads at head_dim 128, bf16, ~8.2 B (144 KiB of KV per token). DRAFTER DFlashDraftModel, 5 layers, bf16; its config.json carries an `auto_map`, hence trust-remote-code.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup 9.09% (a 19-request phase, 20 requests discarded), bounded at 220 requests with a 5400 s safety cap, so about 200 requests are scored.
workload: `configs/data/sharegpt-qwen3-220.jsonl`, 220 single-turn ShareGPT first turns, greedy, posted as plain completions; cut by `configs/data/make-dataset.py` at seed 0. Prompts 4 to 975 tokens, mean 211.1. Output length is fixed per row at the reply's own token count, 4 to 781, mean 217.2, 47,774 over the file, and ignore_eos is set, so every request emits exactly its declared count. Nothing is shared between prompts.
purpose: An 8-billion-parameter chat assistant with a draft model, answering varied open-ended prompts for 16 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line, at commit 21792520e727676e4d4e8bd24a8fe29da4dab152. The interpreter
# and the hardware seal are in configs/env.yaml.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B

# KEEP THIS ON ONE LINE OF INLINE JSON. The declaration is read line by line, keeping only
# `key: <scalar>` or `key: <inline JSON>` and skipping indented lines, so spelled as a block
# mapping this key is DROPPED WHOLE and the engine comes up with NO DRAFTER AT ALL, silently, at
# rc=0. The drafter is named here rather than as `model`, which is the spelling this file uses.
speculative-config: {"model": "nm-testing/dflash-qwen3-8b-speculators", "method": "dflash", "num_speculative_tokens": 64}

# Mandatory, not decoration: the drafter's config.json maps its config class to a `config.py` in
# the repo, and without this flag the engine cannot load it.
trust-remote-code: true

tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-seqs: 16
enforce-eager: true

# The prefill budget, pinned rather than left to resolve -- do not drop it as "the default".
# Nothing in the request file comes near it; the longest prompt is 975 tokens.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# Off so that every request is a real prefill. The 220 ShareGPT first turns are independent
# conversations with no shared prefix, so it is inert here either way.
enable-prefix-caching: false
